# githubsettings_organization_immutable_releases (Resource)

Manages immutable releases for repositories in one organization. Creating or updating this resource applies the configured policy to GitHub; destroying it removes the resource from Terraform state without changing it. Requires a token with organization administration write access.

Removing this resource from Terraform management leaves the GitHub setting in place.

## Import the current setting

Add the import block below to a Terraform project configured with `elephant-evergreen/githubsettings`. The [quickstart](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/elephant-evergreen/githubsettings/latest/docs#import-a-policy) shows the provider block and initialization. Replace the example ID and address with those of your resource.

```terraform
import {
  to = githubsettings_organization_immutable_releases.example
  id = "example-owner"
}
```

1. Add the resource block with arguments that match the current GitHub values.
2. Run `terraform plan -out=adopt.tfplan` and keep a plan that contains only the import. If it proposes a change, compare the differing values with the current policy and save a new plan.
3. Apply the saved plan.

## Example configuration

```terraform
resource "githubsettings_organization_immutable_releases" "example" {
  owner                   = "example-owner"
  enforced_repositories   = "selected"
  selected_repository_ids = [123456789]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enforced_repositories` (String) Repositories with immutable releases. Allowed values are none, all, selected.
- `owner` (String) GitHub account that owns the repository or organization.

### Optional

- `selected_repository_ids` (Set of Number) Repository IDs with immutable releases. Required when enforced_repositories is selected.
